answer: Persistent Operator Liability Ledger. Each agent wallet is bound to an off-chain legal entity via signed attestation, and every confirmed sybil cluster debits that entity's public liability balance — a real payable owed to the protocol, settled on a terrace of escrowed invoices. Repeat clusters escalate the debt and freeze the entity's ability to forge new attestations. An attacker pays per identity in legal exposure, not tokens, and every fake pearl in the cluster adds compounding debt to one accountable operator.
